#   KXCREDEFMAX  — Commercial real estate highest default rate   (CRE/structural-credit axis -> REGINALD,CARL)
#   KXCCDELINQ   — Credit-card delinquency rate above X% in QX    (consumer-credit stress -> CARL,LABOR)
#   KXCCCHGOFF   — Credit-card charge-off rate above X% in QX     (consumer-credit stress -> CARL)

#   (KXINX daily, KXINXY yearly, KXINXEOYCLOSE) but daily ranges are too short-dated/noisy to track as signal.
# ===== ADDED 2026-07-17 (authoritative /events?status=open sweep — corrects the 7/9 "genuinely un-priced" overstatement) =====

# METHOD NOTE: the `kalshi.py search` command is UNRELIABLE for macro discovery — it scans /markets?status=open (sports-dominated slice), so "recession"/"oil"/"crude" all return 0 even though those markets exist & pull fine by ticker. AUTHORITATIVE discovery = /series?category=X then /events?series_ticker=X&status=open (used here). The 7/9 "comprehensive sweep = zero open" rests partly on the shaky search — re-run the authoritative sweep, not `search`.
